aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, as designated by the study; no further stage criteria are provided in the abstract.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: During a median follow up of 11.5 years, 2,598 cases of prostate cancer (including 287 advanced cases) have been identified among 27,004 men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
study_design: Prospective cohort analysis within the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: During a median follow up of 11.5 years, 2,598 cases of prostate cancer (including 287 advanced cases) have been identified among 27,004 men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
reason: The initially cancer-free screening-trial cohort was followed for incident prostate cancer. The abstract separately analyzes total, non-advanced, and advanced incident prostate cancer, including a numeric advanced-disease association for genistein.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: After adjustment for confounders, an increased risk of advanced prostate cancer [HR (95% CI) for quintile (Q) 5 vs. Q1] was found for the dietary intake of total isoflavones [1.91 (1.25-2.92)], genistein [1.51 (1.02-2.22), daidzein [1.80 (1.18-2.75) and glycitein [1.67 (1.15-2.43)] (p-trend for all associations ≤0.05).
estimate_classifications.reason: The reported genistein HR of 1.51 is explicitly for advanced incident prostate cancer, not total prostate cancer.
